summary: A spare, effective depletion beat. Both lines are natural, playable and brief; the progression from empty rocket bag to last missile to anti-tank grenade clearly turns the action toward desperate close combat.

lines.speaker: MOSTAFA
issues: The report is necessarily functional and could be spoken by almost any private; it carries little specifically Menoufia or Mostafa texture.

performance.delivery: He keeps his empty hand inside the bag for half a beat, then looks at Sayed. Report the fact quietly, as if saying it aloud makes their danger real.
He watches the impact, then sees the empty launcher. Let a tiny breath of laughter escape before the words; he is speaking mainly to himself, not celebrating.
